briefdescription.para: Date and time utility routines for canopy model.

detaileddescription.para:
This module contains utilities for manipulating date and time representations, originally adapted from NCAR's MM5 utility code and modified for use with Models-3/CMAQ system and canopy-app.
NCAR, T. Otte, P.C. Campbell
Originally 2001, adapted for Canopy-App August 2023
